phase_a_orientation.summary: NotificationScheduler.runOnce(limit) fetches up to limit pending tasks from NotificationTaskRepository, then for each task marks it SENT before invoking NotificationSender.send(taskId), incrementing and returning the processed count. Dispatch is synchronous and ID-only. The model defines PENDING, PROCESSING, and SENT, but the current repository contract only supports finding pending tasks and marking them sent; PROCESSING is unused, with no claim/lease, retry, or failure handling visible.
